title: Valabalalai - Legion goes into battle: a song about star wars
description: The final (I hope) version of the song "Legion goes into battle" is dedicated to the clones of the Great Army of the Republic, the attack aircraft of the Galactic Empire and the first order! Based on the song "Chechnya burns."  The English version of the song ("Ballad of the Legion"): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Q9NU1T52YSG  Thanks to the co -author to Ruslan Tardaev!  The Geek channel Valaybalalay is dedicated to science fiction, fantasy and other genres of cinema, games, books, series and comics. We delve into the history of characters and monsters, heroes and villains, come up with interesting and crazy theories, talk about the most interesting! On this channel you will learn the most interesting about other worlds: from horrors to science fiction, from fantasy to cyberpan! Subscribe and click the bell so as not to miss new videos!  For advertising and cooperation, write in personal messages in VK: https://vk.com/natalia_adisom   All the necessary links:   Valiya in VK: https://vk.com/valybalalay Public: https://vk.com/valyBallaytv Streams: https://www.twitch.tv/valaybalalaytv Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/valaybalalaytv/ Twitter: https://www.facebook.com/valyBallaytv/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/valaybalalay Monthly support of the channel: https://you.support/valybalalay Single support of the channel: http://www.donationalrts.ru/r/chepacheps Discord (voice chat): https://discordapp.com/invite/j2upyas

asr.full_text: Here's the inventor, the helmet, the rifle, the detonator, we're on the edge again, the droids are on the brink, the whole galaxy is on fire, and the innocent are suffering, the Jedi are throwing us out, the clones are killing us, the Jedi are fighting, the villages are burning, the cities are burning, the planets are burning, the sectors are burning, the Camino and the Lunda, the Tamir, the Felucia and the Dantuin, we're shoulder to shoulder, the Venoters are in the sky, we're coming home alive, but the Legion is going in. The band is weak, the band is free, we sleep, I sing quietly. Only we have all won, the clone war is forgotten. As the Jedi once again rose up, the turmoil began to spread everywhere. Once again the city is restless. The air is treacherous. The rebels are all sticking to us. But we are not shaking now. With the shoulder to shoulder we tear the enemies. With the knife, the rifle, the fistle. We would come home alive. But the legion goes to battle. Among the stars we were looking for you where we hadn't been. Again the alarm signal, the enemies are at the door. In the dark jungles on the Evin, in the hot tufts of the Tatus. With the power of the imperial dynasty we defeat you, the Jedi, with the guns, the fistle. We would come home alive. But we are not shaking to the fistle, but we are not all walking to the fistle, but we are not all walking to the fistle, but we are not all walking to the fistle, but we are walking to the fistle, but we are not all walking to the fistle, but we are not all walking to the fistle, but we are not to the fistle. We fought as lions to the last, but the empire is gone, the war is deadly, they lie in the ruins of the city, far from the homelands, the day comes, the hour comes, the galaxy will remember us, brothers, we must retreat to give the wounds time to heal, we hear your pre-death war, for the legion will return to battle, I am angry, we have not forgiven, your brothers have not forgotten, and the armies are preparing, the hour of payment is very near, the flame will burn again, the empire will be born again, you are all afraid, we are at your doorstep, the villages, the cities, the planets, the sectors of Agatha, Jayachariah, Correa, and Korney are burning, we are coming to you, we are not going to the house of the new leader of the army, A.
